page_title: CAG 1-0 VER | Cagliari v Verona 29/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+1' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Mathis Lambourde (Verona) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
89' Adam Obert (Cagliari) can't believe his eyes as he misses a big opportunity to convert a rebound. The ball brushes the left post.
88' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
87' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom right corner and forces a good save out of Lorenzo Montipo.
84' Substitution. Daniel Mosquera (Verona) on for Tomas Suslov.
84' It is time for a substitution. Mathis Lambourde (Verona) is on for Reda Belahyane.
82' Here is a change. Zito Luvumbo is going off and Davide Nicola gives the last tactical orders to Adam Obert (Cagliari).
81' Diego Coppola (Verona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
79' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
77' Today's match ends for Roberto Piccoli who will be replaced by Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
75' 1 - 0 Goal! Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Mattia Felici, then sends the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Darko Lazovic departs the field of play to be replaced by Abdou Harroui (Verona).
73' Paolo Zanetti has decided to substitute Casper Tengstedt and he is replaced by Grigoris Kastanos (Verona).
70' The percentage of ball possession is – 66:34.
68' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) gets on the end of the free kick, but somehow sends his header well wide of the right post from close in.
66' Here's the change. Dailon Rocha Livramento leaves the pitch and Amin Sarr (Verona) comes on as a substitute.
66' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Cagliari out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
65' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Cagliari for a penalty. Play continues.
63' Suat Serdar (Verona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
61' Tomas Suslov (Verona) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
60' Davide Nicola prepares a substitution. Nadir Zortea is replaced by Mattia Felici (Cagliari).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gianluca Lapadula trots off the pitch and is replaced by Nicolas Viola (Cagliari).
59' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
57' Darko Lazovic (Verona) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the bar.
53' Suat Serdar (Verona) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.
50' Darko Lazovic (Verona) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
48' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Alen Sherri as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
46' Davide Nicola has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Michel Adopo comes on the pitch for Razvan Marin (Cagliari).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Golden chance! Darko Lazovic (Verona) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
45+1' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes narrowly over the bar. Terrific solo effort, though.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Darko Lazovic (Verona).
42' Close! Casper Tengstedt (Verona) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
39' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Nadir Zortea.
36' Darko Lazovic (Verona) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
34' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Cagliari.

34' What a great chance for Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
33' The linesman makes the right call and Cagliari will have a corner.
31' The current number of shots on goal is 0:0.
27' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
26' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) will take the corner.
25' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
20' Reda Belahyane (Verona) finds Tomas Suslov with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
17' Cagliari are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
14' An attempted cross from Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) is cleared.
12' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) gets inside the box and tries to beat Alen Sherri with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
10' Cagliari earn a corner.
10' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
6' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
6' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) prepares to take a corner kick.
5' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
3' The referee signals a free kick. Verona are going to take it from long range.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Verona will have the kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani is the one to supervise the game today.
